purpose: Allow a fresh agent to discover and resume Campaign V3 from durable Git/runtime state without a chat-supplied campaign ID, branch ID, loop ID, state digest or checkpoint.
campaign_qualification: campaign checkpoint is ancestor of current Git HEAD
at least one branch source.kind is STEERING_LEDGER_RESIDUAL
branch_selection: consider only steering branches in active-width states
more than one active branch returns HOLD_AMBIGUOUS_BRANCH
one bound branch delegates discovered coordinates to fresh_resume_branch
identity_ambiguity: zero valid steering campaigns returns HOLD_NO_VALID_STEERING_CAMPAIGN
more than one valid steering campaign returns HOLD_AMBIGUOUS_CAMPAIGN
the cold boot never picks a scalar winner from ambiguous durable state

observed_current_repository_boundary.interpretation: Campaign V3 libraries exist on the branch, but no durable RHC campaign instance is present there yet; real cold resume therefore remains HOLD_NO_CAMPAIGN until a campaign is explicitly started and returned to Git.

non_mutations: does not choose among multiple active steering branches
does not execute a steering action
does not infer hidden campaign state from chat
